I have successfully configured VLC media player to allow pausing/starting the video using a keyboard shortcut without needing to switch from the PDF reader.

**Configuration Summary:**
- Accessed VLC's Tools > Preferences > Hotkeys tab
- Assigned the global hotkey **Ctrl+Alt+Space** to the Play/Pause action
- Saved the preferences

**Result:** You can now press **Ctrl+Alt+Space** while reading your lecture notes in the PDF reader to pause or play the video in VLC. The global hotkey works from any application, so you don't need to switch focus away from the PDF reader to control the video playback.

The hotkey was tested and confirmed working while the PDF reader is in the foreground.
